title: ICL Is Provably Bayesian Inference, audited by Beam 1.0 501B (clean conditions)
blurb: The headline flip: two claims that stayed inconclusive through 7 recorded rounds of 27B-class models (Bayes-Gap/context coupling C2, distribution-shift stability C5) came back supported under Beam on clean conditions, and the risk identity C1 was recovered in one attempt (rel_diff 0.0008). C3/C4 honestly falsified on Beam's own implementations; C6/C7 inconclusive with failing controls flagged.
